description: This file defines the interface for a radix tree data structure used in the lighttpd project, including function prototypes for creation, deletion, insertion, removal, lookup, and iteration over the tree.

methods.name: li_radixtree_new
methods.description: Creates a new radix tree instance.

methods.name: li_radixtree_free
methods.description: Frees the radix tree and its contents, with an optional custom free function.

methods.name: li_radixtree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-data pair into the radix tree, overwriting existing data if the key exists.

methods.name: li_radixtree_remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the radix tree and returns its associated data.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup
methods.description: Performs a longest prefix match lookup for a key.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup_exact
methods.description: Looks up a key with exact match.

methods.name: li_radixtree_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all elements of the radix tree, applying a callback function.
